description: Lists, per target locale, every key whose current value a provider, the translation memory, a fuzzy match, or an AI agent wrote and that no person has approved yet, with the provenance of that value. The queue is computed from the committed locale files, verbatra.lock.json, and verbatra.provenance.json, so every teammate sees the same one. Use it to find the translations waiting for a person, and to report them to the user. Each entry's reasons are the flags the last translate run on this machine gave the key, empty when it gave none; lastRunAt says when that run finished. A key leaves the queue once its value is approved or rejected (review.approve, review.reject, or the Studio dashboard), or a person rewrites or imports it; a key corrected through translation.editEntry stays listed, because an agent's edit still needs a person's review. available: false with reason provenance-unreadable means verbatra.provenance.json is corrupt or from a newer verbatra, not an empty queue. Takes no parameters. Read-only: it calls no provider and writes nothing.
name: review.queue
